patterns.note: Sections alternate between a full-bleed hero or large image and content blocks with a contained width, often centered, creating a balanced visual flow.
A sophisticated serif font is used for prominent headings and the main brand name, contrasted with a clean, highly legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, often in uppercase.
The site primarily uses a rich, dark green and a warm, light cream as primary background and text colors, accented by a deep red for calls to action.

A prominent modal popup appears after a short initial scroll and remains persistently visible, overlaying content, until the very end of the page, requiring user interaction to dismiss or scrolling past all content.
Content sections are visually differentiated by alternating background colors (dark green and light cream) and often feature large, high-quality photographic elements.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text legibility, centered with the brand's elegant typography.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented at the top of the viewport, maintaining access to key links throughout the user's scroll journey.

A unique persistent modal popup is triggered on initial scroll, remaining fixed over the content for the majority of the page's length, requiring a manual close or reaching the page's end to disappear.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with smaller, often uppercase sans-serif subheadings and a comfortable, readable body text size.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant throughout the design, with only subtle rounding applied to interactive elements like the primary call-to-action button.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used, with ample vertical separation between content blocks and generous internal padding, contributing to a premium and unhurried reading experience.

standout: The most distinctive design choice is the persistent, full-width modal popup that appears early in the scroll and remains visible, overlaying content, for almost the entire page length. This creates a highly unusual and attention-demanding interaction, forcing engagement with the booking prompt.
